turns.text: Certainly! Making products available at specific times can create a sense of exclusivity and urgency, which can increase interest and desire among consumers. This timing strategy often targets those who value unique experiences or deals and can influence purchasing behavior by creating FOMO (fear of missing out). It’s particularly effective for products related to personal health and hygiene, like menstrual products, where consumers might be more motivated by special offers or new designs.
